description: This Java class extends the BlobType to customize binary large object (BLOB) data type handling in PostgreSQL databases within Liquibase. It overrides methods to map the longblob to oid in PostgreSQL for ORM consistency.

classes.name: PostgreSQLBlobType
classes.description: A custom data type class for PostgreSQL that maps longblob types to oid to maintain consistency with Hibernate ORM.

methods.name: toDatabaseDataType
methods.description: Overrides the parent method to return 'OID' type for PostgreSQL databases, otherwise defers to the superclass implementation.

methods.name: getPriority
methods.description: Overrides the parent method to increase the priority to ensure this type is preferred for applicable databases.
